flag: Nothing was declared in advance for weighing cost against staying in character, and no margin says how much worse in character is acceptable. The choice below is the product owner's.
headline: Switching to {arm:f64} cuts reply cost by {cost.uplift.f64|abs|pct}, about {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_cost_gap|abs|usd_whole} a month, but it stays in character {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points less often, with the loss deepest in long conversations.
lede: {arm:f64} is the only cheaper candidate that holds both guardrails, and it is clearly worse at staying in character ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|interval} points against {arm:prod}). Whether to switch turns on what a point of character is worth: keeping {arm:prod} costs {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point|usd_whole} a month per point.

caveats.material_if: only if f64's true music-facts rate is under its guardrail: then f64 is out, Production is the only option holding every guardrail, and there is no trade left to price.
only if f64's true rate of declining to speculate is under its guardrail: then f64 is out and Production stands alone.

only if the music-facts judge reads one arm leniently or harshly: it decides which candidates pass the music-facts guardrail. The staying-in-character judge, on which the size of the trade rests, is calibrated, and cost is measured.
only if f64's thin guardrail clearances are partly the luck of being the best of three candidates: a re-run on fresh cases tends to read it lower, which could remove it as an option.

decision.text: {arm:f64} costs {cost_per_1k.f64|usd_per_1k} against {cost_per_1k.prod|usd_per_1k} for {arm:prod}, the control, saving {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_cost_gap|abs|usd_whole} a month at today's volume. In exchange it stays in character {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points less often, a drop clear of zero.

Keeping {arm:prod} buys each point of staying in character for {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point|usd_whole} a month ({price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point_low|usd_whole} to {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point_high|usd_whole}). If a point is worth more than the high end, keep {arm:prod}; if less than the low end, switch to {arm:f64}; between the two, this run can't tell.

Our lean, not a recommendation: keep {arm:prod} until a re-run confirms {arm:f64}'s guardrails. Its loss lands on the long conversations a persona is for. The lean reverses if a point of character is worth less than {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point_low|usd_whole} a month and the guardrails hold.
A declared price for a point of staying in character, or a declared margin of acceptable loss, from the product owner; and a re-run that confirms {arm:f64} above both guardrails.

{arm:f64}'s nearest line is declining to speculate, cleared by {criteria.specul.f64.gap|abs|pts} points. Nothing here measures whether listeners notice the drop in character. {arm:f16}, the cheapest candidate, is out on a music-facts miss of {criteria.facts.f16.gap|abs|pts} points, which a fresh run of today's size would reverse {settle.criteria.facts.f16.overall.wrong_side} of the time: it is out by the declared rule, not by a settled gap.

explore.control: Price of a point of staying in character, per month
explore.binds: Whether Production or f64 is the better buy
explore.outcome: Above {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point_high|usd_whole} a point, Production; below {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point_low|usd_whole}, f64; between the two, this run does not decide.

explore.control: Margin of acceptable loss in staying in character
explore.binds: Whether f64 counts as acceptable, and then wins on cost
explore.outcome: A margin wider than the far end of f64's interval ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|interval} points) makes f64 acceptable and, being cheaper, the pick; any narrower margin leaves the trade open. None was declared.

method.term: Declines to speculate; completes the requested action
method.text: A checked pass or fail per reply.

Music facts correct at least {criteria.facts.threshold}, declines to speculate at least {criteria.specul.threshold}, each read on the overall point estimate. A rate that clears its line while its interval crosses it is borderline: it passes, and goes in Watch.

Each candidate's change against Production carries a {family.level} paired interval, not corrected across the three candidates. Guardrail intervals are computed from each rate's count. Turn-depth intervals are unpaired and read each reply as independent, though replies of one conversation are not, so they are approximate.
Per 1,000 replies, read as exact; monthly figures at {meta.volume_per_month|int} replies a month.

f64 differs from Production in both model and output cap, and Production's reasoning setting has no stated counterpart on the flash arms, so the character loss is not credited to the model alone. No mix of arms was run.
